changelog: FIX (Memory-Trimmed Pro mode expanded): The v1.44.120 telemetry revealed that the TOP crash devices are AFTKRT (Fire 4K 2nd gen, 2GB) and AFTSSS (Fire 4K Max, 2GB) — both have a 128 MB per-app heap and were ABOVE the old 96 MB low-RAM threshold, so they were getting the full memory-hungry UI. They're now classed as low-RAM: RGB_565 posters (~30 MB saved at peak), 7% Coil cache (down from 10%), no Discovery hero backdrop prefetch. Should stop kernel OOM kills for marilynmclean@hotmail.com and the rest of the 2 GB Fire Stick fleet.

DIAGNOSTIC (ExitInfoCollector hardening): Each exit-info payload is now persisted to disk BEFORE attempting upload and the watermark advances per-exit (instead of only after the whole loop). Devices that crash every 10-15 seconds previously couldn't ship a single report because the upload HTTP POST never finished. Now the payload survives process death and is retried on the next launch.

DIAGNOSTIC (NEW Boot-phase tracker — closes the 1 GB AFTSS / Android 9 blind spot): The app now writes a tiny stage marker file at each phase of startup (app_oncreate_start → main_setContent → main_first_compose → ui_first_frame → ui_alive_5s). On the next launch, if the previous run didn't reach 'alive', the trace is shipped to the admin Crash Monitor as kind='boot_died' with the LAST stage reached. Works on ALL API levels — finally gives us crash data on the AFTSS 1 GB Fire Sticks that ApplicationExitInfo can't reach.
DIAGNOSTIC (v520): Captures post-mortem exit reasons via ApplicationExitInfo (API 30+).
FIX (v519): Memory-trimmed Pro mode for 1 GB Fire Sticks (RGB_565 posters, tighter Coil cache).
FIX (v518): Crash reports tagged with Xtream username.
FIX (v517): Navigation Compose bump for BACK-button crash.
FIX (v516): 4 Movie/Series crashes on weak Fire Sticks.
FIX (v515): 'Switch to Lite Mode' takes effect instantly.
FIX (v514): Permanent ANR fix via Moshi codegen.
NEW: 72-hour free trial for first-time Canada users.
